## System Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph Tenants[Tenant Workloads]
        T1[LPAR Tenant A]
        T2[z/OS Workload B]
        T3[Container Tenant C]
        T4[LinuxONE Tenant D]
    end

    subgraph Broker[Mainframe-Aware Accelerator Isolation Broker]
        AUTH[Authentication & Attestation]
        NS[Model Namespace Manager]
        MQ[Memory Quota Enforcer]
        KM[Key Material Vault]
        SP[Accelerator Scheduling Policy Engine]
        DF[Data-Flow Boundary Gate]
    end

    subgraph SpyrePool[Shared Spyre Accelerator Pool]
        subgraph Cell1[Sealed Inference Cell A]
            S1[Spyre Execution Slice]
            M1[Isolated Model State]
            C1[Private Cache]
        end
        subgraph Cell2[Sealed Inference Cell B]
            S2[Spyre Execution Slice]
            M2[Isolated Model State]
            C2[Private Cache]
        end
        subgraph Cell3[Sealed Inference Cell C]
            S3[Spyre Execution Slice]
            M3[Isolated Model State]
            C3[Private Cache]
        end
        IDLE[Dynamic Idle Capacity Pool]
    end

    T1 --> AUTH
    T2 --> AUTH
    T3 --> AUTH
    T4 --> AUTH
    AUTH --> NS
    NS --> MQ
    MQ --> KM
    KM --> SP
    SP --> DF
    DF --> Cell1
    DF --> Cell2
    DF --> Cell3
    IDLE -.->|Safe Reassignment| Cell1
    IDLE -.->|Safe Reassignment| Cell2
    IDLE -.->|Safe Reassignment| Cell3
```

## Sequence Diagram

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant T as Tenant LPAR / Container
    participant B as Isolation Broker
    participant ATT as Attestation Service
    participant KV as Key Material Vault
    participant SCH as Scheduling Policy Engine
    participant SC as Sealed Inference Cell
    participant SP as Spyre Accelerator Slice

    T->>B: Submit inference request
    B->>ATT: Verify tenant identity & attestation
    ATT-->>B: Attestation record confirmed
    B->>KV: Retrieve tenant key material
    KV-->>B: Encryption keys issued
    B->>SCH: Evaluate priority & residency rules
    SCH-->>B: Assigned execution slice & quota
    B->>SC: Create sealed cell with namespace + memory quota
    SC->>SP: Execute inference on isolated slice
    SP-->>SC: Return inference result
    SC->>SC: Scrub model state & cached artifacts
    SC-->>B: Encrypted result
    B-->>T: Deliver inference response
```

## Isolation Boundary Model

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph TenantBoundary[Per-Tenant Isolation Boundary]
        MNS[Model Namespace]
        MEM[Memory Quota]
        KEY[Key Material]
        ATR[Attestation Record]
        POL[Scheduling Policy]
        DFB[Data-Flow Boundary]
    end

    subgraph Enforced[Enforced Separation Guarantees]
        NP[No Cross-Tenant Prompt Visibility]
        NE[No Shared Embeddings]
        NM[No Model State Leakage]
        NC[No Cache Artifact Bleed]
    end

    MNS --> NP
    MEM --> NE
    KEY --> NM
    DFB --> NC
    ATR --> NP
    POL --> NE
```

## Dynamic Capacity Pooling

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle: Spyre slice available
    Idle --> Allocated: Broker assigns to tenant
    Allocated --> CellCreated: Sealed cell provisioned
    CellCreated --> Inferencing: Model loaded in namespace
    Inferencing --> Scrubbing: Inference complete
    Scrubbing --> Sanitized: State + cache purged
    Sanitized --> Idle: Slice returned to pool
    Allocated --> PriorityPreempt: Higher priority request
    PriorityPreempt --> Scrubbing: Preempted tenant evicted
```

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph IBMZPlatform[IBM Z / LinuxONE Platform]
        LPAR1[LPAR 1]
        LPAR2[LPAR 2]

    end

        direction TB
        ADMIT[Admission Control]
        TENANT_REG[Tenant Registry]
        RESID[Data Residency Rules]
        PRIO[Workload Priority Queue]
        AUDIT[Audit & Compliance Log]
    end

    subgraph SpyreCards[Spyre PCIe Accelerator Cards]
        CARD1[Spyre Card 1]
        CARD2[Spyre Card 2]
        CARD3[Spyre Card 3]
    end

    LPAR1 --> ADMIT
    LPAR2 --> ADMIT
    ZOS --> ADMIT
    CONT --> ADMIT
    ADMIT --> TENANT_REG
    TENANT_REG --> RESID
    RESID --> PRIO
    PRIO --> CARD1
    PRIO --> CARD2
    PRIO --> CARD3
    CARD1 --> AUDIT
    CARD2 --> AUDIT
    CARD3 --> AUDIT
    AUDIT --> TENANT_REG
```

They break many renderers and image export. - Use shorter labels, multiple nodes, or subgraphs instead of forcing line breaks inside one label. INVENTION: --- invention-id: invention-20260622-105920 company: IBM created: 2026-06-22T10:59:22 --- # Invention Idea Use IBM Spyre accelerator cards as a shared AI inference pool behind mainframe-grade logical partitions, but add a container-like isolation layer that treats each tenant workload as a sealed inference cell. Each cell would have its own model namespace, memory quota, key material, attestation record, accelerator scheduling policy, and data-flow boundary before it can access Spyre resources. The novel step is a mainframe-aware accelerator isolation broker that maps containers, LPARs, or z/OS workloads onto Spyre execution slices while enforcing tenant separation, workload priority, and model/data residency rules. This would allow high-value AI inference workloads to share expensive accelerator capacity without one tenant seeing another tenant’s prompts, embeddings, model state, or cached inference artifacts. The optimization angle is that idle Spyre capacity can be safely pooled and reassigned dynamically, while the security boundary remains closer to mainframe isolation than ordinary GPU sharing. IBM describes Spyre as an AI inferencing PCIe add-on for IBM Z and LinuxONE systems OUTPUT: ## System Architecture `mermaid flowchart TD subgraph Input[Data Sources] A[Source A] B[Source B] end subgraph Process[Processing] C[Tracker] D[Detector] end subgraph Output[Results] E[Clean Data] F[Alerts] end A --> C B --> C C --> D D --> E D --> F ` ## Sequence Diagram `mermaid sequenceDiagram participant S as Source participant T as Tracker participant D as Detector participant Sys as System S->>T: Submit Data T->>D: Validate D->>Sys: Forward or Block ` Create diagrams specific to THIS invention.
